# @sarj/oxlint-plugin

Sarj source policies for stock Oxlint

```bash
npm install --save-dev @sarj/oxlint-plugin
```

Rules and configuration are documented in the generated rule directory.

Oxlint's `--fix` applies safe fixes; other findings require a source change. Run the check again after fixing, since one fix can expose another finding.

Better Tailwind rules use the consumer's Tailwind 3 or 4 installation. Conflict detection and Shadcn theme checks require Tailwind 4.

[Documentation](https://code-standards.sarj.ai/rules/oxlint/) · [Source](https://github.com/sarj-ai/code-standards)
